plainText:
(Japanese: 時の歯車をとりもどせ！！ Take Back the Time Gears!!) is the second chapter of the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Totodile and Honō successfully join the Wigglytuff Guild.
Honō senses that is in trouble.
Honō and Totodile confront the Time Gear thief, Grovyle.
With the aid of Dusknoir, Grovyle is captured.
Dusknoir reveals that Grovyle is a thief from the future and sends him forward in time.
Dusknoir sends Honō and Totodile to the future as well.
